The expert list is a union of names found on the M3000 C.O.R.E. page (Room shape, Size, Early/Reverb level, Rev width, Rev Delay 'build up', Rev diff) and Rev-3 page (Diffuse, Distance, Diffuser type, Mod Rate/Depth, three crossovers): see MAPPING-M2000-M3000.json. This is a wording observation, not a TC statement.

notes: printedPageOffset = PDF page - printed page. M2K-EN, M2K-FR and M2K-CC: 0 (printed page n = PDF page n; measured by research/page_offsets.py on the folios); M3K-EN: 2. Every citation uses printed pages. TC-REVCMP and the KB pages have no folios.

status: 'confirmed' = the manual prints, for this very parameter, the full range (min and max; unit when one is printed, otherwise unit = null, e.g. Pitch 0-1200) or the full label list in an order; 'unknown' = not printed or only partly printed (the printed parts are kept in min/max/unit/unitHint/lcdExample and the note says what is missing); 'conflict' = two M2000 readings disagree (EN vs FR, text vs LCD), all readings are in 'readings' and in the note.
step is null everywhere: no M2000 resolution is printed. An editor must then edit the 0-127 CC value directly and may show the printed endpoints only.

editIndex is null everywhere: the manual never shows a complete Edit page (see unknowns). descriptionIndex (added field) is the 0-based position in the printed USER (or EXPERT) PARAMETERS list of the program page, Mix and Out Level excluded; it is NOT evidence of the Edit-page order (contradicted on p.22 for the Reverb) and must not be used as CC = 12 + descriptionIndex without a hardware observation.

Added fields: algorithm.expertModeEvidence, algorithm.variants/variantsCite, algorithm.notes; param.descriptionIndex, param.layer (user|expert), param.kind (value|action), param.unitHint (unit seen only in an LCD example), param.lcdExample, param.valueCount (number of values printed without labels), param.labelComposed (label built from a collective description), param.readings (conflicts); mix/outLevel.minLabel (printed lower end that is not a number); system[].pairing (how the M2K-CC name was paired with a manual field: name, abbreviation, meaning, none), system[].rangesByMode, system[].readings, system[].lcdExample, system[].unitHint; cc.* text fields; routingsOrderEvidence, routings[].lcdNumber/lcd.
mix = null means the program page lists no Mix (EQ, Dynamic).
Speed ranges are printed as sweeps per second ('1 sweep every 10 seconds to 10 sweeps every second') and stored as 0.1-10 Hz.
